;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**After 1,000 days of civil war in [[Yemen]], eight million people are at risk of starvation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-middle-east-42442463/starvation-in-sanaa-1000-days-of-yemen-s-civil-war (BBC)]
*[[United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital|Protests on U.S. recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital]]
**Two [[Palestinians]] are shot dead and about 60 others are wounded by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli troops]] gunfire as thousands protest along the [[Israel–Gaza barrier|Gaza border fence]], in all seven  [[West Bank]] cities  and in [[East Jerusalem]], against the U.S. declaration. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel-palestinians/two-palestinians-killed-in-anti-us-protests-after-u-n-vote-on-jerusalem-gaza-ministry-idUSKBN1EG1GC (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economics of bitcoin]]
**The digital cryptocurrency [[Bitcoin]] loses a third of its value within 24 hours. [http://money.cnn.com/2017/12/22/investing/bitcoin-plunges-below-14k/index.html (CNN)]
*[[CSX Corporation]] names chief operating officer Jim Foote its new chief executive officer, succeeding [[E. Hunter Harrison]] who died last week. Harrison had started a restructuring campaign less than a year ago. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-csx-ceo/csx-names-foote-as-ceo-following-death-of-harrison-idUSKBN1EG22Y?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Apple Inc. litigation]]
**[[Apple Inc.]] faces backlash and lawsuits after admitting to slowing down the speed on some of their older phones deliberately. [https://www.cnet.com/news/apple-iphone-slowdown-sparks-fraud-lawsuit/ (CNET)] [http://www.businessinsider.com/two-class-action-lawsuits-apple-iphone-throttling-2017-12 (''Business Insider'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*The [[Philippine Coast Guard]] reports that 252 passengers and crew have been rescued while five people were killed when a ferry capsized Thursday east of  [[Manila]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-ferry/philippines-coast-guard-rescues-252-passengers-from-capsized-ferry-idUSKBN1EG08F?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital]]
**Palestinian President [[Mahmoud Abbas]] says he will not accept any U.S. plan for peace with Israel, because it recognized [[Jerusalem]] as Israel's capital. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42453530 (BBC)]
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[United Nations Security Council]] unanimously imposes new sanctions on [[North Korea]] that caps refined petroleum product imports to 500,000 barrels a year, a 90 percent cut, and  demands the repatriation of North Koreans working abroad within 24 months. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles/u-n-security-council-imposes-new-sanctions-on-north-korea-idUSKBN1EG0HV (Reuters)]
*[[Ukraine–United States relations]]
**The U.S. agrees to supply Ukraine with more lethal weapons, now including [[FGM-148 Javelin|Javelin]] anti-tank missiles. [http://www.nydailynews.com/newswires/news/national/officials-lethal-weapons-headed-ukraine-article-1.3716611 (AP via ''New York Daily News'')]

;Law and crime
*The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] arrests Everitt Aaron Jameson, a 25-year-old former [[United States Marine Corps|Marine]], on suspicion of planning a terrorist attack in the [[Pier 39]] area over Christmas. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-42462463 (BBC)]
*[[United States|American]] [[police]] shoot dead an [[Egyptians|Egyptian]] man after he opened fire on them. Police described it as an apparent terror attack.[https://www.cnn.com/videos/us/2017/12/24/pennsylvania-police-shootings-dhs-nd. (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
* [[Catalan regional election, 2017]]
** Pro-independence parties retain their absolute majority in the [[Parliament of Catalonia|regional parliament]], while the unionist  [[Ciutadans|Citizens]] party secures the highest number of seats. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42451100 (BBC)]
**The political situation means that there is no clarity as to which party is given the right to form the government. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42450745 (BBC)]
**The voter turnout reaches a record high for a Catalan regional election of over 83%. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalan-separatists-win-election-in-rebuke-to-spain-and-eu-idUSKBN1EE2WW (Reuters)]
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Home Office]] confirms the return of the blue [[British passport]] after the UK leaves the [[European Union]]. The new passports will be issued from October 2019. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-42443253 (BBC)]
*[[Tax reform#United States|Tax reform in the United States]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs the [[Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017]] into law. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/22/politics/trump-sign-tax-bill-mar-a-lago/index.html (CNN)]
